summary: Frontend-only i18n/microcopy validation for DynoPay auth/wallet/pay-link/profile flows. ALL scoped items PASS: (1) /auth/register renders fully in DE and NL when language is switched via the header dropdown — no raw camelCase i18n keys leak in en/de/nl; (2) /auth/login renders fully in DE with no raw keys; (3) Add Wallet modal helper texts (walletNameHelper, walletAddressHelper) render as proper English AND German copy — no raw keys; (4) Profile page renders in DE with no raw keys; (5) Mobile (390px) bottom nav labels render localized ('Dash | Transaktionen | Erstellen | Wallets | Mehr') with no raw keys. HOWEVER I found ONE important behavior deviation from the task brief and several out-of-scope English-leftovers worth flagging (see below).

integration_issues.issue: IMPORTANT: The task brief tells testers to use localStorage key 'i18nextLng' — this is WRONG. The app actually uses localStorage key 'lang' (plus 'lang_manual'='true' to lock manual selection). Setting 'i18nextLng' has NO effect (the page still renders EN). Setting 'lang' works and persists across reloads. Please update /app/memory/test_credentials.md / testing docs. Using the header language dropdown works correctly in all cases.

action_items: Localize the Email/Mobile Number toggle tabs on /auth/register (login page already does this correctly — copy the same t() keys).

Provide a way to reach PaymentSettingsBasic without company+wallet onboarding gate, OR provide a hostbay JWT so helper texts (valueHelper/clientNameHelper/expiryRecommendation) can be visually verified in DE. Currently unverifiable via UI on the empty QA merchant.
Fix testing doc: correct localStorage key is 'lang' (not 'i18nextLng') — update /app/memory/test_credentials.md and the review-request template so future i18n tests don't get stuck.

(Follow-up backlog — outside this pass) Extend i18n coverage to: /create-pay-link onboarding gate, /wallet empty-state info banner + 'What is a payout wallet?', Profile page 'Change/Add Phone/Update Password/Login Activity' block, sidebar 'Customers/API/Referrals/Settings', mobile dashboard KPIs & CreateCompany modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: The advertised i18n microcopy work (Add Wallet modal helpers, register-page strings, login-page fallback strip, mobile bottom nav) all correctly renders localized copy in DE/NL and does NOT leak any of the 30+ camelCase keys the brief listed as regression risks.

Positive: Language dropdown persists to localStorage 'lang' + 'lang_manual' and survives full reload; SSR-EN + client hydrate transition is fast (~2s) with no visible key-flash for the scoped surfaces.
Minor consistency issue: the same Email/Mobile Number segmented control is localized on /auth/login but hardcoded English on /auth/register — likely a missed t() call on the register variant.
Documentation drift: The review request/test_credentials advertise the wrong localStorage key ('i18nextLng'). This will trap future testers/agents.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For DynoPay i18n testing: (1) DO NOT use localStorage 'i18nextLng' — use localStorage 'lang' (values en/de/nl/es/fr/pt) plus optionally 'lang_manual'='true'; a reload is required because SSR always renders EN. Easier: click the header EN/flag dropdown and pick 'DE - Deutsch' etc. (2) Auth-gated pages: OTP-Redis scripted login works cleanly — POST /api/user/login → read Redis key 'login_otp:<session>:json' → POST /api/user/verifyLoginOTP. Send User-Agent Mozilla/... Chrome/120 header. JWT lasts 1h. (3) The empty QA merchant cannot reach the payment-settings form; use hostbay@moxx.co for full pay-link testing. (4) Screenshots for this run saved under /app/.screenshots/ (register_de/nl, login_de, wallet_addmodal_en/de, paylink_en/de, profile_de, mobile_dashboard_de).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this pass was a verification run, not a bug fix. The one behavior deviation ('i18nextLng' not respected) has a clear root cause: the app stores language under 'lang' (see behavior observed — dropdown writes localStorage.lang='de' and reload preserves the language). The review-request/docs mentioning 'i18nextLng' is stale/incorrect documentation, not an app bug.
